options_english: The total kinetic energy is constant
The angular momentum about the centre of force is constant both in magnitude and direction
The total potential energy is not constant
The particle always moves in a plane perpendicular to the direction of the angular momentum

In motion under central conservative forces, the total potential energy is constant because conservative forces depend on the position of the particle and on its velocity.

questions.explanation_english: • A system that undergoes an irreversible process may still be capable of returning to its initial state. • An irreversible process increases the entropy of the universe. Example of irreversible processes - • Free Expansion. • Transfer of electricity through a resistor. • Mixing of the matter of different states. • Energy Transfer as heat with finite temperature difference. • Motion against friction. • Mixture of non-identical gases.
